title: Tag stability window and customer upgrade journey (staged deprecation & release notes cadence)
creator: Olivia Martinez
description: Scope: establish an operational playbook that defines a 'tag stability window' for model and API tags, the end-to-end customer upgrade journey, and a synchronized release-notes & comms cadence. This ticket centralizes the PM-run runway: decision on stability window length, compatibility policy (how many previous tags we keep supported), standard migration guide templates, internal reviewer checklist, and go/no-go criteria for each phase. Goal is to reduce unexpected customer breakage during model/tag rollouts while minimizing platform maintenance burden.
acceptance_criteria: Documented tag stability policy with explicit window (weeks) and supported compatibility guarantees
Release-notes template and comms schedule validated by GTM and Support
Migration guide template and CLI/SDK snippet examples created and linked
Internal runbook for escalation, rollback, and canary checks assigned to eng on-call
Cross-team signoffs recorded (Engineering, Design, Support, Security, GTM)
updates: 2026-02-12: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Marco Alvarez), Design (Aisha Patel), Support (Sasha Chen). Agreed on primary goals and high-level constraints.

2026-02-18: Eng provided telemetry summary (ENG-8321) showing majority of customers use latest two tags; preliminary recommendation: 8-week stability window with 2-tag compatibility shim. Action: PM to validate with customer-facing teams.

2026-02-25: Draft release-notes cadence proposed: 2 weeks before deprecation announcement, 1 month of 'safe upgrade' guidance, final deprecation notice 2 weeks before enforcement. Shared with GTM for feedback.
2026-03-03: Design review complete. Design created banner mockups and in-console migration nudges (DES-1123). Minor accessibility adjustments requested.
2026-03-08: Legal and Security confirmed no additional compliance blockers for the proposed timeline; security_review_required=false recorded.
2026-03-10: Support playbook drafted with triage flows and canned responses. Identified two high-risk enterprise customers; Solutions Eng to run assisted migrations (owners assigned).
2026-03-12: PM review with leadership; approved to proceed to detailed runbook. Next: produce final migration guide artifacts and schedule a customer webinar week of 2026-04-06.
playbook_steps: Define tag stability window (decision: 8 weeks) and compatibility policy (support last 2 tags + compatibility shim for 4 weeks)
Prepare release-notes package: overview, breaking changes section, migration steps, CLI/SDK snippets, and 'how to pin' guidance
Create in-console banners and email templates for each customer segment (self-serve, enterprise with account manager)
Run internal canary: route 2% of traffic to staged deprecation path for 7 days, monitor latency/errors/token costs
Open support channel checklist and schedule 48-hour on-call coverage during final enforcement window
Execute gradual enforcement: advisory -> opt-in warning -> soft-enforce -> full enforce, each stage gated by telemetry thresholds
rollout_timeline: 2026-03-15: Finalize migration guide and release-notes templates
2026-03-22: Publish preview release-notes to internal docs and solicit GTM feedback
2026-03-29: Begin customer outreach for enterprise cohort (account managers)
2026-04-06: Public announcement + knowledge base article + customer webinar
2026-04-20: Soft-enforcement window starts (warnings only), monitor for regressions
2026-04-30: Full enforcement of tag deprecation policy if metrics within acceptable thresholds
risk_mitigation: Metric gates: abort or extend if error-rate > 0.5% above baseline or if >2 high-severity incidents in a 48-hour window
Fallback: ability to re-enable deprecated tag shadowing for affected customers for up to 2 weeks
Assisted migration: Solutions Eng assigned to top 10 paying customers with automated rollback hooks
Communication: two-week and 48-hour reminders plus in-console links to migration docs
follow_up_tasks: Create automated script to identify customers still pinned to deprecated tags (ENG-8400)
Localize release notes and KB articles for EU and APAC customers
Add telemetry dashboard panels showing pinning rate, upgrade rate, and user errors
Schedule post-mortem and customer feedback survey 2 weeks after enforcement
